description:
Read a store's event feed after a cursor: order.created/paid/confirmed/expired/refunded, order.mismatch (a payment named the order id but not its quote; the order is unchanged), order.duplicate_payment (the order was paid twice; the creator refunds the second), order.checkout_paid_again (a second order confirmed for a checkout session that was already paid; both delivered, and only the seller can send a payment back), order.reverted (a paid order undone by a chain reorg), entitlement.granted/consumed/revoked, entitlement.expiring (a timed item is about to run out) / entitlement.expired, drop.claimed/awarded, drop.exhausted (a drop gave out its last item), sku.sold_out (an item reached its max supply), store.not_live (the store stopped selling because its plan lapsed) / store.live (selling again). Keep `last` and pass it as `after` next time; the same events arrive as iap.<type> webhooks, and this feed is how you catch up on any you missed. Store key scope: events:read.

Params: store_id, after? (event id), limit?, session_token?
Returns: {entries: [{id, type, wallet, orderId, payload, createdAt}], last}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_list_events
title: List store events
